Name: TT's   cuter   shoes
Author: lll98lll
Description:
I really like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36010]Lunys Vanilla Swirl Body[/url] and add 3 cuter shoes for it through Fashion Sense. Dyeable.
我真的很喜欢这个体型！为了搭配衣服，为[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36010]Lunys Vanilla Swirl Body[/url]绘制了稍微更可爱贴身的鞋子，长中短共三款，可以染色。
Regarding the issue of parts of the legs disappearing, it can be solved by selecting 'barefoot' in the settings.
关于部分腿部消失的问题，可以通过在设置选择“barefoot”解决。
